headline: OS-binary enrichment: which Windows built-in binaries (LOLBAS catalog, ~215 entries) does a repo actually invoke, joined with categories, MITRE IDs, and detection references. Content-addressed on {pack commit, findings, hit locations} so the same repo state hashes identically run-to-run.

capabilities.label: Scan a repo for LOLBAS-catalogued Windows binary invocations (strict mode, read-only, no ledger writes)
capabilities.notes: Read-only: never passes --ledger, so no .audit/recon-ledger.jsonl writes when called through the seam. Strict mode only (extension-required matches). Pack read from $LOLBAS_PACK_PATH or the vendored services/lolbas/pack/LOLBAS_PACK.json. Zero findings is a valid answer (found:true, finding_count:0) -- absence of LOLBAS hits does not mean absence of shell-outs. {root} is a forward-slash path.
triggers: what windows binaries does this touch
